newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA TO CONSIDER BOND ISSUE IN AUTUMN.
newsitem.headline: HANSA TO CONSIDER BOND ISSUE IN AUTUMN.

text.p: Hansapank, Estonia's leading commercial bank, said on Monday it might consider a Eurobond issue this autumn.

Hansapank might mull the issue when the bank has been assigned a rating, if a need exists and when the market conditions are favourable, Erkki Raasuke, head of interest rate products and financial risks at the bank, told Reuters.
"If those conditions are filled, we might issue bonds in September, October or November," he said.
Raasuke added the bank might need to refinance some previous loans and improve its liquidity by that point in time.
Hansapank is not considering the issue earlier, because it recently received a 100 million DM syndicated loan and is also due to receive a 15 million DM subordinated loan soon.
